item.description:
1. Clear the session to initialize Postman test script variables.
2. Issue a CSRF token for the session.
3. Authentication as a user
4. Reissue the CSRF token after authentication.
    

| User | Variable |
| --- | --- |
| Admin | `{{EMAIL_ADMIN}}` |
| Guest | `{{EMAIL_GUEST}}` |
| Manager | `{{EMAIL_MANAGER}}` |
| Publisher | `{{EMAIL_PUBLISHER}}` |
| Root | `{{EMAIL_ROOT}}` |
| User | `{{EMAIL_USER}}` |
